movie.mainStoryPrompt: Silent Minecraft adventure. Steve and Alex walk with a Sniffer through a cherry grove. The Sniffer catches a scent and follows it toward a meadow, but a small river blocks the way. Steve and Alex place stepping-stone blocks so the Sniffer can cross. On the far side it digs up an ancient torchflower seed. The seed rolls down a slope, Alex catches it, and together they plant it beside the Sniffer. No dialogue, no narration, no combat.
movie.storySummary: Steve และ Alex พา Sniffer เดินผ่าน Cherry Grove เมื่อมันได้กลิ่นเมล็ดโบราณและเดินตามไปจนติดแม่น้ำ ทั้งสองช่วยสร้างทางข้าม จากนั้น Sniffer ขุดพบ torchflower seed ที่เกือบกลิ้งหายลงเนิน ก่อน Alex จะเก็บไว้และปลูกให้มันสำเร็จ

scenes.title: Cherry Grove Walk
scenes.description: Steve, Alex and a Sniffer walk beneath cherry trees.
scenes.actionDescription: Steve และ Alex เดินข้าง Sniffer ใต้ต้น cherry ที่กลีบสีชมพูปลิวเบา ๆ
scenes.imageDescription: Recognizable Minecraft Steve and Alex walking beside a large red-green Sniffer under pink cherry blossom trees, bright blue sky and petals, family-friendly.
scenes.videoPrompt: Gentle side tracking shot through the cherry grove. Audio: light breeze, petal rustle, cheerful adventure music, Sniffer footsteps. No speech.

scenes.title: A Scent
scenes.description: The Sniffer stops and raises its head to smell the air.
scenes.actionDescription: Sniffer หยุดเดินและยกหัวดมอากาศ ขณะที่ Steve และ Alex หยุดตาม
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft Sniffer in a cherry grove lifting its broad head to sniff, Steve and Alex standing nearby, bright pink petals and grass.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow push-in on the Sniffer as it sniffs and turns toward a meadow path. Audio: soft sniffing, discovery chime. No speech.

scenes.title: Follow the Trail
scenes.description: The Sniffer walks quickly toward a flower meadow.
scenes.location: ทุ่งดอกไม้ (Flower Meadow)
scenes.actionDescription: Sniffer เดินนำออกจาก cherry grove ไปยังทุ่งดอกไม้ โดย Steve และ Alex ตามหลัง
scenes.imageDescription: Bright Minecraft meadow with colorful flowers, Sniffer leading while Steve and Alex follow from cherry grove edge.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear tracking shot following the group into the meadow. Audio: grass steps, upbeat music, bees in distance. No speech.

scenes.title: River in the Way
scenes.description: A small river blocks the Sniffer's path.
scenes.location: ลำธารทุ่งหญ้า (Meadow River)
scenes.actionDescription: Sniffer หยุดที่ริมลำธารและมองไปอีกฝั่งที่มีกลิ่นนำทางต่อ
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft Sniffer at a narrow clear river, Steve and Alex beside it, flower meadow continuing on far bank, sunny daylight.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow crane up to reveal the river between the group and the far meadow. Audio: water flow, music pauses lightly. No speech.

scenes.title: Stepping Stones
scenes.description: Steve and Alex place stone blocks across the river.
scenes.location: ลำธารทุ่งหญ้า (Meadow River)
scenes.actionDescription: Steve และ Alex วาง stone block เป็นทางข้ามสั้น ๆ เหนือน้ำ
scenes.imageDescription: Recognizable Minecraft Steve and Alex placing a line of stone stepping blocks across a small meadow river, flowers on both banks.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side tracking shot following several stone block placements across the water. Audio: block placement clicks, gentle music builds. No speech.

scenes.title: Sniffer Crosses
scenes.description: The Sniffer carefully crosses the stepping stones.
scenes.location: ลำธารทุ่งหญ้า (Meadow River)
scenes.actionDescription: Sniffer เดินข้ามบล็อกหินทีละก้าวไปถึงอีกฝั่ง
scenes.imageDescription: Large Minecraft Sniffer carefully walking over stone stepping blocks across a clear river, Steve and Alex watching encouragingly.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low side tracking shot following the Sniffer's slow crossing. Audio: heavy soft footsteps, water, playful music. No speech.

scenes.title: Digging Time
scenes.description: The Sniffer begins digging at one patch of grass.
scenes.location: ทุ่งดอกไม้ (Flower Meadow)
scenes.actionDescription: Sniffer ก้มหน้าขุดพื้นหญ้าบริเวณหนึ่ง ขณะที่ Steve และ Alex ยืนดู
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft Sniffer digging into a grassy flower meadow, Steve and Alex behind it, dirt particles and bright flowers, no danger.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium shot as the Sniffer digs one spot. Audio: dirt digging, anticipation music, birds. No speech.

scenes.title: Ancient Seed
scenes.description: A torchflower seed pops out and rolls down a small slope.
scenes.location: ทุ่งดอกไม้ (Flower Meadow)
scenes.actionDescription: torchflower seed กระเด็นออกจากดินและกลิ้งลงเนินเล็ก ๆ ไปทาง Alex
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft torchflower seed item rolling down a grassy slope from the Sniffer toward recognizable Alex, bright meadow flowers.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low tracking shot following the seed rolling downhill toward Alex. Audio: item bounce, playful music cue. No speech.

scenes.title: Caught
scenes.description: Alex catches the seed before it reaches the river.
scenes.location: ทุ่งดอกไม้ (Flower Meadow)
scenes.actionDescription: Alex ก้าวมารับ torchflower seed ไว้ก่อนมันกลิ้งถึงน้ำ
scenes.imageDescription: Recognizable Minecraft Alex catching the torchflower seed at the bottom of a grassy slope while Steve and Sniffer approach, sunny meadow.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium shot as Alex catches the seed in one motion. Audio: item pickup sound, happy musical accent. No speech.

scenes.title: Torchflower Garden
scenes.description: Steve and Alex plant the seed beside the happy Sniffer.
scenes.actionDescription: Alex ปลูก torchflower seed ในแปลงเล็กใต้ cherry tree ขณะที่ Sniffer นอนพักข้าง ๆ
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft cherry grove at golden afternoon, Steve and Alex beside a small planted torchflower with a relaxed Sniffer nearby, pink petals drifting.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pull-back from the planted torchflower to Steve, Alex and Sniffer under cherry trees. Audio: gentle music resolution, breeze, soft Sniffer sound. No speech.
